rand3.description: uniform random 3-SAT at the satisfiability threshold (CNFgen randkcnf, clauses sampled without repetition, uniform literal signs)

col3.description: graph 3-coloring of a uniform random graph G(n, m) sampled by generate.py with random.Random(seed) and saved as a DIMACS graph (CNFgen gnm ignores --seed); encoded by CNFgen kcolor: at-least-one and pairwise at-most-one colour per vertex, one binary clause per edge and colour

assign.description: coupled task assignment: exactly one allowed resource per task, at most `capacity` tasks per resource, conflicting tasks never share a resource
